text:
```yaml
name: Update NuGet Package Lock JSON

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - renovate/**
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-lock:
    uses: SonarSource/dotnet-tooling/.github/workflows/dotnet-restore.yml@main
    with:
      solution: SonarScanner.MSBuild.sln
      restore-args: --force-evaluate
    secrets: inherit

  commit-lock:
    needs: update-lock
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Commit lock file changes
        id: commit
        run: |
          if git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM | grep -E '\.lock\.json$'; then
            git add $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM | grep -E '\.lock\.json$')
            git commit -m "Update NuGet package lock files"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}
            echo "committed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "committed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Show commit status
        run: 'echo "Committed: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.committed }}"'
```
